voiceName: George, warm British storyteller (ElevenLabs premade voice)

lines.text: Good news starts a list of deadlines. In a country whose language you do not read.
A.I. Daddy reads along and says nothing, until life happens. Then it researches the live web with Exa.
Each line has the sentence it came from. Our server opened that page again, and found the sentence.
Tap a number. The official page opens at that sentence.
A letter in Finnish. Three Exa searches on official sites, every cited page read twice.
When two sources disagree, it shows both. It does not pick one in silence.
Nineteen scenarios, every quote found on its page. Six seconds, three cents.
A.I. Daddy. Research with sources, in your family chat.
